current_activity: strikes toward the Zon bridge to cut the Market Garden corridor; nearly takes the 101st Airborne command post
notes: Event date: late afternoon of 19 September 1944 (D plus 2) (MacDonald, chs. 7 and 8). Event definition: Rerouted from Aachen to the First Parachute Army, the brigade strikes toward Zon late on 19 September to sever the corridor of the British ground column; the 101st Airborne Division command post and the Bailey bridge at Zon almost fall (MacDonald, chs. 7 and 8; Wikipedia). notes: Event date: 30 September to 2 October 1944 (MacDonald, ch. 10).
